title: Vampire Vape Shortz Sourade
description: Shortz Sourade from Vampire Vape delivers a sublime sour kick from fresh, ripe lemon. The bright citrus tang of authentic lemons play perfectly with this juice’s subtle sweet and sour note for an e-liquid that’s sharp, refreshing and absolutely delicious. These shortfill bottles contain 50ml of nicotine-free liquid, with 10ml of extra space within the bottle to accommodate your nicotine shot of choice. This allows you to create a liquid with your own desired nicotine strength. Typically, adding a 10ml nicotine shot to a 50ml shortfill will give you 60ml of 3mg e-liquid. Once you have added your preferred amount of nicotine, make sure to shake the contents of the shortfill bottle well.
